question: Should this release remove the remaining root bundled skills and make Sherpa ONNX TTS an official ClawHub-only plugin?
rationale: The change intentionally selects a shipped deprecation boundary and transfers an official capability to registry and native-artifact dependencies; code inspection cannot choose that product and release policy.

options.title: Migrate, verify, then land
options.body: Add a doctor migration for every removed shipped reference, obtain exact-head dependency approval, and verify the official Sherpa package and native artifacts before merging.

options.title: Retain bundles for now
options.body: Keep the affected bundled skills available for this release and defer removal until the migration and external availability contract are ready.

options.title: Accept the breaking boundary
options.body: Merge the removal as an intentional breaking change with explicit release notes and release-owner acceptance of lost legacy references and external availability risk.

recommendation.title: Migrate, verify, then land
recommendation.body: Add a doctor migration for every removed shipped reference, obtain exact-head dependency approval, and verify the official Sherpa package and native artifacts before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged split PRs established the current plugin ownership and ClawHub lifecycle boundary, making them the strongest available owner for the remaining release decision.
